A complete copper-alloy finger ring, now slightly bent on one side of the hoop. Measuring 22.45mm in external diameter and 19.53mm in internal diameter. The hoop is quite narrow, 2.25mm at its narrowest point, but flares at the shoulders, where it is 4.5mm wide. The bezel is flat, rectangular in shape and slightly wider than the width of the hoop (measuring 14.63mm in length by 5mm in width).…
